subject: Run-rate to reserve translation — renewal sizing proposal
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@lumina.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procure Team <procure@lumina.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity ask + usage snapshot for upcoming renewal

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We pulled together the usage snapshot for the last three months — you'll see a steady run-rate but with two short 48-hour spikes tied to product launches (rows highlighted). The renewal window is mid-June and we need a clear translation from our observed run-rate into a recommended reserve so internal finance can sign off.

Key asks:
- A conservative reserve (min GPUs) we can commit to for the 12-month term.
- A recommended buffer for launch spikes (how many additional GPUs to burst).
- Any suggested transition steps from our current burst-heavy setup to a predictable reserve.

Attached: Lumina_usage_snapshot_Mar2028.csv

Can you take a pass and share a short MAP (mutual action plan) and recommended sizing by Friday? I can loop in procurement if you need a formal quote afterward.

Appreciate it —
Samantha
Samantha Cole
Head of Platform Ops, Lumina AI
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@lumina.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask + usage snapshot for upcoming renewal

Samantha —

Thanks for the snapshot, this is very helpful. High level takeaways from our quick glance: your steady-state (P50) aligns with ~18 A100-equivalent slots; the launches drove short-lived 36-48 hour bursts that pushed you to ~52 slots.

I'm attaching a working capacity matrix (capacity-matrix-v1.xlsx) that maps run-rate percentiles to reserve sizes, and one conservative proposal below:

Proposal A (conservative reserve):
- Reserve: 22 GPU slots (A100-equivalent)
- Burst pool: 32 additional slots for launches (ad-hoc, billed at burst rate)
- Autoscaling policy: 2-minute scale step, 10s min latency headroom target

Transition plan (3 months):
1) Month 1: Establish reserve at 18 (match current P50) + enable burst pool for launches (measure latencies).
2) Month 2: Move to Reserve 22 if observed P75 trends persist.
3) Month 3: Finalize 12-month commit at chosen reserve; add scheduled burst credits for known launches.

If that sounds reasonable I can convert this into a short MAP with milestone dates and a single-line SOW for procurement.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: capacity-matrix-v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@lumina.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 10:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity ask + usage snapshot for upcoming renewal

Mina / Samantha —

Quick add from my side: given Lumina's recent feature cadence and the two clear launch spikes, I recommend sizing the reserve to cover anticipated base load + 1.2x of predictable marketing-driven spikes. Practically that pushes the commit to 25 slots as a compromise between cost predictability and performance risk.

Operational notes:
- Recommend pinning critical models to the reserve pool; non-critical/experimental models should default to hosted burst.
- Consider a scheduled warm-up 12 hours before launches to pre-populate KV caches — this reduces tail latency dramatically and lowers effective GPU need.

I can put together the math quick (cost delta vs. burst) if you want to present to procurement.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@lumina.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Bcc: contracts_team@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Run-rate to reserve translation — renewal sizing proposal

Samantha —

Great — thanks for the quick responses everyone. Based on the notes above and a short cost/latency run we did, attached is a concise MAP and the recommended commitment we think balances cost and runway:

Final recommendation (for procurement):
- 12-month reserve: 25 A100-equivalent slots
- Burst pool: 30 slots available at the burst rate; 3x scheduled burst credits for planned launches during the term
- Milestones:
  * 2028-06-01: Sign SOW (initial billing start date 2028-06-15)
  * 2028-06-15: Reserve goes live at 18 (safety staging)
  * 2028-07-01: Reserve moves to 25 (post first launch validation)

Actions for Lumina: please review the attached MAP-Lumina-May2028.pdf and confirm any procurement constraints (billing contact, PO cadence). I placed a HubSpot deal link and a placeholder DocuSign in the related links for your convenience. If procurement gives the green light I will route a formal SOW to contracts_team@redwood.ai and get the DocuSign out the same day.
